fields.title: Identifier
fields.description: The name of this feature in the form 'namespace_name:feature_name'. 'feature_name' must match the filename.

fields.title: Allow Adjacent
fields.description: Whether neighbors of the same block type are allowed. Will result in blocks being placed with at least one block gap when set to false

fields.title: Bark Side Only
fields.description: If true, will never place the block on the 'open' side of a block (imagine the block is a fallen tree trunk).
